| **Repo** | `box/debian` |

Skill-prose bundle for the debian image family: owns the `debian`, `debian-builder`, `debian-debootstrap-builder`, `debian-debootstrap` `skill:`
entities (sibling nodes in this file) and carries their bodies under
.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
It exists because a `skill:` node's owner must be a candy, not an image — an image has
no source directory, so an image-owned node's prose is unreadable and the skill is
absent from the ai.opencharly.skill OCI label (opencharly/sdk#434).
Composed into every image that carries one of those skills. Charly installs the body of
every skill an image composes under the image user's ~/.agents/skills and labels it
ai.opencharly.skill (kind:skill's owned content, opencharly/sdk#598), so a harness in the
image reads the same prose the label carries; this candy owns the nodes and ships no
install step of its own.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | every skill body this candy carries is installed under the uid-1000 account's ~/.agents/skills |
